runners.comment: Made pleasing return from long absence when close third of 13 at Wetherby in January
runners.name: Ionity
runners.spotlight: Placed all three starts since winning over C&D (good to soft) in May 2024, most recently when creditable third of 13 at Wetherby (2m3f, soft; hampered on run-in) in January, after a long absence; not yet proven on heavy ground but still features prominently in calculations.

runners.comment: Took step back in right direction when fourth at Chepstow last month; still on good mark
runners.name: Bolsover Bill
runners.spotlight: Generally very disappointing since returning from long absence in the autumn but took step back in right direction when respectable fourth (just behind Onehundredneighty) at Chepstow (2m3f, soft) last month and remains very well handicapped.

runners.comment: Out of form when last seen in the autumn and probably needs much better ground than this
runners.name: Wild Nephin
runners.owner: K P Marsh Plastering & Interiors Ltd
runners.spotlight: Now 8lb lower than when winning on good ground last March but was out of form over hurdles and fences in early part of this season and the forecast slow ground is a big worry on his first start for four months.

runners.comment: Belied 150-1 odds when staying-on third on recent handicap debut at Chepstow
runners.name: Onehundredneighty
runners.spotlight: Showed no significant promise in three novice/maiden hurdles (2m-2m1f) towards end of last year but belied 150-1 odds when staying-on third on recent handicap debut at Chepstow (2m3f, soft) and it will be interesting to see whether he can build on that performance.

16:30.race_name: Amroth Bay Caravan Park Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Dual soft-ground winner; back over hurdles last time there were feasible excuses
runners.name: Chief Sunday
runners.spotlight: Won two soft-ground handicap hurdles last season, the latest off only 3lb lower and that form has worked out well; didn't take to chasing and when back over hurdles at Lingfield he made a notable mistake and perhaps found an extended 2m3f too far; no surprise if he fares better here.

runners.comment: Qualifying runs not devoid of promise and he's got the scope to improve with racing
runners.name: Francky Blue
runners.spotlight: Latest fourth at Chepstow (beaten 26l) was behind the useful Bossman Jack and this 5yo has the scope to improve with his racing; hard to rule out on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Leicester winner in November but comfortably beaten otherwise this season
runners.name: Sophie Power
runners.spotlight: Nosed home off this mark at Leicester in November (soft) but comfortably beaten otherwise this season; the hood is reapplied for the first time since Leicester but she's not overly convincing.

runners.comment: Only had two runs and could easily have it in him to be competitive on handicap debut
runners.name: Maestro Du Mesnil
runners.spotlight: Beaten 10l (good) and 15l (soft; tongue tied) in his first two races but the winner last time is now 3-4 over hurdles and this 4yo could easily have it in him to be competitive on handicap debut; market could be instructive.

runners.comment: Suffient promise in juvenile hurdles to believe he can threaten on handicap debut
runners.name: Bouquet De Paris
runners.spotlight: Owned by Andrew Balding, for whom he was third in a 1m novice on sole Flat start; has shown enough in juvenile hurdles (hooded last time) to believe he can threaten in a handicap of this nature, provided he copes with the ground (unraced on softer than good to soft).

runners.comment: Up 6lb for recent win but looks a good bet to give her running on ground she handles
runners.name: Inion Tiogair
runners.spotlight: Headed to Chepstow last time as a 15-race maiden over hurdles but had been running well and under a patient ride she won with plenty in hand; up 6lb but looks a good bet to give her running on ground she handles.

17:00.race_name: 3A's Motorhome Hire 'Junior' National Hunt Flat Race (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Stable is 0-17 in bumpers last five seasons but this Flat bred cost 80,000euros as a 3yo
runners.name: Chapeau David
runners.spotlight: Stable is 0-17 in bumpers the last five seasons but this Flat bred cost 80,000euros as a 3yo and he's a half-brother to a winning hurdler.

runners.comment: Beaten 5l in a slowly run bumper at Carlisle (good to soft); only runner with experience
runners.name: Jimmy Gatz
runners.spotlight: Bought for 30,000gns as a yearling; out of a mare who won over 8.5f on dirt in America but the sire gets jumps winners; difficult to know what he achieved when beaten 5l at Carlisle (good to soft; 3-1) as that was slowly run and the form has yet to be tested; heavy ground might not be ideal but he's clearly a strong contender having shown some ability.

runners.breeder: S C E A De La Vallee De LOrne
runners.comment: Half-brother to AQPS Flat winners Furda D'Airy and Kernie D'Airy and a point winner
runners.name: Maucourt dAiry
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-brother to AQPS Flat winners Furda D'Airy and Kernie D'Airy and point winner Iriko D'Airy; dam French 2m1f-2m6f chase winner; stable has had three bumper winners in recent seasons; should handle the conditions given pedigree.

runners.comment: Bred to stay well so that will help on the ground; stable respected in these races
runners.name: Mojito Lido
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother to point/3m1f hurdle winner Hilnamix; dam French 2m7f chase winner; stable does well in bumpers, and with newcomers; respected.
